item.summary: fix(agents): publish resolved model identity in agents_list output (#123044) agents_list exposed the raw configured primary (routing alias) as the model field while agentRuntime was derived from the resolved model, giving agents two contradictory identities. Publish the resolved provider/model from resolveDefaultModelForAgent instead, matching the gateway agents.list fix (#122907).
